meta.title: Messages: risks of unbounded history
meta.subtitle: Why replaying every old turn forever becomes a production problem

views.label: Core path
views.note: More retained history means more context pressure; production systems eventually need to manage what is supplied.

cards.title: Cost and latency
items: Longer prompts use more input tokens.
More context generally means more work per request.

cards.title: Relevance and freshness
items: Old context can become stale or irrelevant.
Previous AI output is not automatically verified truth.

cards.title: Privacy and security
items: Sensitive data may be replayed when it is no longer needed.
Untrusted instructions can persist if history is resent blindly.

cards.title: Finite context window
items: History competes with the current request and room for the answer.

cards.title: Resource efficiency
items: Unnecessary tokens mean unnecessary serving work.
Exact environmental impact depends on the serving system.
